name: ResearchSpecificRestrictions
summary: The card component of Research Specific Restrictions (DUO_0000012). The requester's project intends to use the data for a research purpose the owner allows, and the requester accepted the terms. Outputs a DataUseConditionCredential about the requester.

allowedPurposes.description: Allowed research purposes. An IntendedDataUseCredential qualifies if any entry of claims.useOnlyFor.purposes is in this list.
